His business focuses on residential and commercial city-centre properties in the Netherlands and Belgium, ranging from historic buildings to new construction.

long_biography.plain_text:
Property developer Vincent Bekke worked on smaller real-estate projects and managed interior-design projects before joining larger residential conversions with City Pads. The partners kept their organisation small and hired specialist expertise for each development. Local investors supplied advance funding, while buildings could be divided into apartment rights and transferred to buyers on completion of the purchase.

Through Bekke & Partners, he later joined Ten Brinke in acquiring Eindhoven's former Philips VB building. The redevelopment provided temporary accommodation for hundreds of students. Housing association Trudo also commissioned five timber residential buildings on the surrounding site, designed by Paul de Ruiter Architects, with 200 social rental homes.
